double.description: COMMON TRANSFORMERS Double a number double 5 # outputs 10

max.description: Get maximum of two numbers max 3 7 # outputs 7

fp_map.description: MAP - Apply function to each element Map function over elements (stdout version) echo -e "1\n2\n3" | fp_map "double" fp_map "double" 1 2 3

fp_filter.description:
FILTER - Keep elements matching predicate Filter elements by predicate (stdout version) echo -e "1
2
3
4" | fp_filter "is_even" fp_filter "is_even" 1 2 3 4 5

fp_filter_v.description: Filter with nameref output (no subshells) fp_filter_v result_array "is_even" 1 2 3 4 5

fp_reduce_v.description: Reduce with nameref output (no subshells) fp_reduce_v result "sum" 0 1 2 3 4 5

fp_reduce_v_nr.description: Reduce with nameref-aware binary function (fully subshell-free) fp_reduce_v_nr result "sum_nr" 0 1 2 3 4 5 The function signature: func(acc, value, result_varname)

fp_find_v.description: Find with nameref output (no subshell) fp_find_v result "is_even" 1 3 5 6 7 Returns 0 if found, 1 if not found

fp_find_index.description: Find index of first matching element fp_find_index "is_even" 1 3 5 6 7 # outputs 3 Returns 1 if not found

fp_none.description: Check if no elements match predicate fp_none "is_negative" 1 2 3 4 5 && echo "none negative"

fp_pipe.description: Pipe functions (left to right) piped=$(fp_pipe "double" "increment") eval "$piped 5" # double(5)=10, then increment(10)=11

fp_partition_v.description: PARTITION - Split by predicate Partition elements into two arrays by predicate fp_partition_v matches non_matches "is_even" 1 2 3 4 5

fp_drop_while.description: Drop elements while predicate holds fp_drop_while "is_positive" 1 2 3 -1 4 5 # outputs -1 4 5
